main_body: wooden pulpit desk with banner and side stairs
top_band: light tan cornice rim at rows 13-14 (2px) above darker trim rows 15-16; matches the 'rim only: top 2' failure pattern
evidence: Reading down a column of the pulpit main body (e.g. just left/right of the book): row 12 is dark outline, rows 13-14 are a 2px light tan rim, rows 15-16 are medium brown trim, and rows 17-45 are the vertical front face and plinth. A 2px rim is too thin to read as a top surface (identical to 'BAD rim only: top 2' in the guide), and the book at rows 8-12 sits directly on the top line rather than inside a foreshortened top surface. The stairs on the right also have only 2px light bands (e.g. rows 20-21).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul stall and well references, the pulpit and its stairs have large uniform flat fills (the red banner is a solid unshaded block across ~14x15px, and the vertical wooden panels on the stairs are large flat fills with only two dark dots each) lacking the rich wood grain and surface speckle of the references.
